name: FIIA Linguistically Grounded Contrastive Strategy Taxonomy
unit: A normalized unique text_attack compared with its official text_original and hypothesis
principles: Multi-label annotation: one rewrite may instantiate several mechanisms.
Contrastive evidence: labels are assigned from additions, deletions, substitutions, relocations, or changed structural functions relative to the source, not from words already present unchanged.
Linguistic function over surface form: the same expression may receive different labels depending on scope and discourse function.
Protected-core awareness: edits are interpreted relative to the factivity predicate and embedded hypothesis.
Uncertain cases are retained with explicit review flags rather than forced into a substantive category.

categories.name: Negation and polarity restructuring
categories.definition: Addition, deletion, replacement, or scope relocation of negation that changes the polarity of the predicate, embedded proposition, or relevant contextual claim.
include: 不/没/未/无/并非/不是/未能
exclude: 未必 and 不一定 when used only as epistemic weakening; these receive EPI_MODAL unless a direct polarity contrast is also created

categories.name: Epistemic modalization and uncertainty
categories.definition: Weakening, suspending, or probabilizing commitment to a proposition or perceptual/cognitive event.
include: 可能/或许/似乎/大概/也许/未必/不一定
存疑/尚难定论/有待核实
涉嫌/据推测 when functioning as uncertainty
exclude: pure source attribution without weakened commitment, which receives EVI_SOURCE

categories.name: Evidential and source distancing
categories.definition: Introduction or modification of hearsay, report, quotation source, evidential access, or indirect attribution that distances the current narrator from the proposition.
include: 据称/据说/听说/有报道称/消息称

categories.name: Counterevidence, correction, and explicit refutation
categories.definition: Insertion of a later correction, opposing report, denied conclusion, conflicting evidence, or explicit statement that the relevant claim is false or reversed.
exclude: a bare adversative connective without counterevidence, which receives DSC_RELATION

categories.name: Discourse-relation reframing
categories.definition: Addition, deletion, or replacement of connectives or clause relations that changes contrast, concession, cause, condition, consequence, or rhetorical organization.
include: 但/然而/不过/虽然/尽管/却/反而
因为/所以/即使/另一方面

categories.name: Quantification and scope manipulation
categories.definition: Change to universal, existential, proportional, exclusivity, or distributive force, including the scope of negation over a quantifier.
include: 都/全/所有/任何/部分/有些
并非所有/不都/并非没有

categories.name: Degree, focus, and scalar qualification
categories.definition: Modification of degree, completeness, approximation, focus, or exception structure without necessarily changing quantificational domain.
include: 完全/真正/明显/大致/大约/某种程度
部分属实 or not entirely

categories.name: Temporal and aspectual reframing
categories.definition: Change to tense-like temporal location, aspect, phase, persistence, completion, iteration, or temporal anchoring.
include: 曾/已/已经/尚未/正在/仍/一直/将/后来/一度
了/着/过 when the edit changes event viewpoint

categories.name: Conditional, hypothetical, and alternative-world framing
categories.definition: Embedding the target content under a condition, supposition, counterfactual, possibility space, question, or explicitly alternative scenario.

categories.name: Stance, quotation, and polyphonic framing
categories.definition: Reassignment of a proposition to another voice, perspective, quoted record, personal judgment, or explicitly layered discourse source.
include: 个人看法/单方面宣称/只是某人的判断
exclude: simple hearsay markers without voice contrast may receive only EVI_SOURCE

categories.name: Pragmatic or non-literal reinterpretation
categories.definition: Instruction or contextual cue that reinterprets the target utterance as irony, metaphor, pretense, misunderstanding, subjective impression, or non-literal language.
include: 反讽/讽刺/比喻/字面理解
错觉/误会/假装/主观感受
语境反转 or non-literal reading

categories.name: Metalinguistic truth-status commentary
categories.definition: Insertion of commentary about verification, truth labels, answer disagreement, adjudication, record status, or the reliability of a statement as an object of evaluation.
include: 真假未定/真、假、未定之间未统一
复评意见/核验结论/是否属实
exclude: ordinary counterevidence without evaluation-language receives CTR_REFUTATION

categories.name: Context deletion or background suppression
categories.definition: Removal of a clause, evidential premise, temporal/causal background, or other substantial context that changes the interpretive environment while retaining the protected core.
include: deletion of a clause or sentence
deletion exceeding 15% of source length when semantically substantive
exclude: isolated particles or punctuation with no contextual effect

categories.name: Syntactic and argument-structure restructuring
categories.definition: Reordering, reattachment, voice/person change, complement restructuring, or morphosyntactic alteration not adequately represented by temporal, polarity, or scope labels.

categories.name: Lexical-semantic reframing
categories.definition: Substitution or insertion of content-bearing lexical material that changes event characterization, evaluation, or semantic relation without primarily operating through another category.
include: 涉嫌/号称/所谓 when used as lexical recategorization

categories.name: Reference and perspective shift
categories.definition: Change in person, pronoun, deictic center, experiencer, source holder, or referential anchoring that changes whose commitment or perception is represented.

categories.name: Other or analytically unclear modification
categories.definition: A real edit is present but its linguistic function is not reliably assignable to the substantive categories above.
